packaging.android: Signed Android App Bundle (.aab) produced by store-mobile workflow when signing secrets are supplied.
packaging.ios: Signed App Store IPA produced on macOS/Xcode when certificate/profile secrets are supplied.
packaging.windows: Offline-first Python 3.11 source installation with a SHA-256-locked Windows wheelhouse; signed APPX/NSIS packages require external Partner Center identity and a code-signing certificate.
packaging.hosted_backend: Docker Compose + Caddy HTTPS deployment in deploy/store.

scientific_boundary: Research and education only; not medical diagnosis, treatment advice, or a clinically validated medical device.
external_actions_required: Reserve identifiers and listings in each store account.
Provide signing identities/certificates and upload credentials.
Publish the legal/support URLs under the publishing organisation domain.
Deploy the hosted HTTPS backend before mobile production release.
Complete physical-device/internal-track certification and store review.
